g.text: Automated Code Feedback -- Logical Data Model
SRS section 10 leaves this undefined. Do not
add a boolean column for it. Derive it as a
view, so changing the definition is one
Ratify the definition in the team meeting and
record it here before Student B writes the view.
Also undefined in SRS section 10. The column
exists, its semantics do not yet. Candidates:
self-reported score from the model, agreement
across providers, or score variance on repeat
sampling. Student A should pick one, write it
down, and keep the units stable, because the
submission_file holds student source code and
student identifiers. Privacy and retention are
listed as out of scope in the SRS, which is
fine for a design doc but not for a deployment.
Raise with Pitt before this holds real student
